name: Donald Trump
role: 45th and 47th President of the United States
summary: A nationalist, populist Republican whose 'America First' program combines tariffs and protectionism, tax cuts and deregulation, strict immigration enforcement and a strong military with socially conservative positions on gender and religion, while leaving abortion and marijuana to the states.

sources.title: 2024 Republican Party Platform
sources.author: Republican National Committee (American Presidency Project)
sources.usedFor: His 2024 program: taxes, tariffs, energy, immigration, military, speech, abortion, gender, religion

sources.title: Political positions of Donald Trump

universal-healthcare.rationale: Called the ACA a 'complete disaster', sought its repeal and favored a 'free-market system' with block-granted Medicaid, despite saying in 1999 he believed in universal health care.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Champions deregulation and supply-side economics, but pairs it with tariffs and protection for domestic industry.

public-ownership.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Cut income taxes as president and his 2024 platform pledges to make the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act permanent; no record of seeking higher taxes on the rich.

unions-good.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

property-fundamental.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Platform promises to 'slash Regulations' and restore Trump-era deregulation, though he has also threatened to regulate social-media platforms he sees as biased.

cut-welfare.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

worker-ownership.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

surveillance-ok.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Mixed record: said states should decide on marijuana and backed Florida's 2024 legalization amendment, but has also taken 'drug warrior' positions.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Platform pledges to 'protect Free Speech online' and bar federal 'censor[ship]' of lawful speech; he has separately called for punishing flag burning.

strong-leader.rationale: Governs under a maximalist reading of executive power and the unitary executive theory, acting heavily through executive orders.

state-harmful.rationale: Seeks to use and expand federal executive power (deportations, tariffs, military), not to abolish the state.

limit-guns.rationale: Calls himself a strong Second Amendment advocate, backed national concealed carry and opposed universal background checks in 2019.

empower-police-military.rationale: Pledges to 'replenish Police Departments', shield officers from lawsuits and make the military 'the strongest and most powerful in the World'.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

decide-locally.rationale: Leaves abortion and marijuana policy to the states, backs local control of schools and wants to close the federal Department of Education.

rehabilitation.rationale: Signed the First Step Act (2018), which expanded recidivism-reduction programs, but campaigns as 'tough on crime' and strongly supports the death penalty.

traditional-family.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Said Obergefell 'settled' the issue and his 2020 campaign said he supported same-sex marriage, after opposing it in 2011.

abortion-legal.rationale: Describes himself as pro-life with exceptions; took credit for Dobbs, wants abortion left to the states and opposes late-term abortion, while saying he would not sign a federal ban.

more-religion-public.rationale: Created a Conscience and Religious Freedom Division and a task force against anti-Christian bias, and backed religious exemptions.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Opposes diversity, equity and inclusion programs and 'CRT' in schools.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Executive Order 14168 defines sex as a male-female binary; barred transgender military service and restricts gender-affirming care.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Said 'Americanism, not globalism' would be his credo, called himself a 'total nationalist' and made English the official language by order in 2025.

gradual-change.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Promises the 'largest deportation program in American history', ending chain migration and moving to merit-based immigration.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Withdrew the US from the World Health Organization (2020 and 2025) and the Paris Agreement, and rejects collective security.

free-trade.rationale: Withdrew from the TPP, waged a trade war with China and imposes broad tariffs; seeks 'Fair and Reciprocal' rather than free trade.

nation-first.rationale: 'America First' is the organizing principle of his platform.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

open-borders.rationale: Promises to complete the border wall and end 'sanctuary' policies.

limit-growth.rationale: Platform: 'DRILL, BABY, DRILL', energy dominance and terminating the 'Socialist Green New Deal'.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Has called climate change a 'hoax' and withdrew the US from the Paris Agreement.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Platform calls for energy 'from all sources, including nuclear'.
